title: Supplier Response
notFound: The requested order could not be found.
errorInvalidOrderStatus: The Supplier Response cannot be shown in the current Status.
errorIncomplete: Cannot confirm - some SKUs are still unanswered. Enter a confirmed quantity for every SKU.
errorInvalidStatusTransition: This action cannot be performed in the current Status.

table.confirmedQtyRequiredHint: This column is required to "Confirm Supplier Response" - enter a value (0 is allowed) for every SKU before confirming. Every other field (Confirmed Delivery, Note, Supply Status, Response Date) is optional.

unsavedChangesBanner: There are unsaved changes. Save before confirming.
confirmDialogBody: Confirms every SKU's response. Cannot be edited afterwards.

agreement.title: Agreement
agreement.adminOnlyIndicator: Only an Administrator can perform this action.
agreement.agreeDialogBody: Agrees to the Supplier Response as-is. The Order Revision itself is not changed - even if there is a difference, the Order's history is preserved exactly as it was.
agreement.forceAgreeLabel: Agree even though some Attention is not yet acknowledged
agreement.errorUnacknowledgedAttention: There is an unacknowledged Attention. Acknowledge it, or select "Agree even though some Attention is not yet acknowledged".
agreement.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
agreement.reopenDialogBody: Please enter a reason to reopen (required). The original Agreement record is never deleted - it is preserved as history.

revision.errorReasonRequired: Please enter a reason for the correction.
revision.createDialogBody: Returns the Order to an editable Draft. The current Order Revision is preserved as history exactly as it is.
revision.applyConfirmedValuesLabel: Apply the Supplier Response's confirmed quantities to the Order quantities
